name: print-social-art-exhibit-posts-cobalt-duotone-portrait-sparkle-icons
title: 'Art Exhibit' posts in deep cobalt with a duotone portrait, glass orb prop and sparkle line icons
whatItMeans: Moody and artistic; the glowing orb prop and duotone photography give a gallery announcement real visual intrigue.
whatItIs: Five deep-blue square posts with a duotone photo of a person holding a glowing glass orb near their face, bold white headlines ('Exhibit 23', 'Join on Tuesday', 'Art Exhibit'), sparkle asterisk and eye line icons, wavy line graphics and event details.
techniques: Duotone a portrait in one deep saturated colour.
Use a glowing prop (orb) as a recurring surreal touch.
Scatter small line icons (sparkle, eye) as gallery-style ornamentation.

vocabulary.definition: A photo of a person rendered in only two colours.
A translucent sphere used as a surreal photography prop.
